# Stage 6 production hardening handoff

## Completed in this node

- Preserved all existing Stage 6 workspace changes; no reset, discard, Stage 7 work, or submodule modification was performed.
- Added and exercised shared forward-only SQLite migration infrastructure and exact version-zero legacy classification.
- Connected a shared Host/Profile `host.db` migration catalog and independent Credential, Relay, and Session catalogs; constructors migrate before opening long-lived connections and ad-hoc duplicate-column migration paths were removed.
- Added production Session trash/restore/tombstone and durable Artifact-reference integration, startup Artifact validation/degraded-mode scaffolding, RetentionLog restart loading with bounded allow-listed I/O, Stage 6 provider/performance testkit, BOM publication, release SBOM/provenance generators, and related tests/docs.
- Targeted SQLite migration/Host/Profile/Credential/Relay/Session suites passed after fixing the observed trash/search and migration-test regressions.
- Repository-external Gradle consumer passed.
- A real Apache Maven consumer was executed on the authorized Ubuntu host: both online and offline compile passed (`STAGE6_MAVEN_CONSUMER_OK`).
- Real OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic smoke runners passed without emitting credentials or payloads; Google remains contract/faux.

## Current verified failures / unfinished work

- The fixed-size Ubuntu performance run is not complete. It reached the required 1,000-session/100,000-item dataset and emitted passing cold/list/search/first-page metrics, but failed during ACK/replay measurement with `FollowUpQueue` capacity exceeded after repeatedly enqueueing without draining. Do not reduce the mandated scale; fix the runner to model bounded queue consumption/ACK semantics and rerun the full 2 vCPU/4 GiB, 2-client, 2-active-run, 16-tool-effect, 10k-replay, 2 GiB Artifact suite.
- The Ubuntu release build failed at Gradle `verifyGenerated` because the `eclipse-temurin:21-jdk-jammy` build image has no `node` executable. Use a controlled JDK 21 + pinned Node toolchain/image and rerun; do not skip `verifyGenerated`.
- Production hardening remains incomplete: permanent Session deletion must be proved to remove command/result/timeline/search/content/Artifact projections without FK obstruction; Artifact startup report ordering and missing/corrupt degraded reads need final correction/tests; migration crash/failure/concurrency coverage needs closure.
- `RemoteHostInstaller` health-failure rollback currently switches the binary symlink but does not restore pre-migration SQLite backups. Add a failing test, then restore only backups created by the candidate migration after stopping the JI user service, remove matching WAL/SHM, switch to the previous binary, restart, and health-check. Do not add down migrations or an online backup API.
- Signed private Host bundle, OCI archive and hardened image smoke, complete dependency-grade CycloneDX/SPDX, artifact signatures, final-tree in-toto/SLSA provenance, install/upgrade/pre-migration-backup/failure-rollback/package smoke, support matrix, complete Stage 0–6 gates, cleanup checks, and final local commit remain outstanding.

## Latest external evidence

- Ubuntu release failure: `verifyGenerated` could not start `node`; build exited 1.
- Ubuntu performance failure: cold ready 539 ms, list p95 4 ms, search p95 374 ms, Session first-page p95 5 ms; ACK samples shown were below 150 ms before the runner failed with `queue capacity exceeded`. These partial numbers are not a passing performance result.

No Stage 6 completion or acceptance claim is made. Continue on the same main workspace, preserve all valid uncommitted changes, and create no commit until every executable Stage 6 exit condition is genuinely green.

# Stage 6 production hardening handoff

## Completed and verified

- Preserved all valid uncommitted Stage 6 work; no reset/discard, Stage 7 work, or submodule modification.
- Shared forward-only SQLite migration infrastructure is connected to Host/Profile, Credential, Relay, and Session catalogs with exact version-zero classification, WAL checkpoint, verified pre-migration backup, transactional schema/data/version advancement, rollback, schema-too-new rejection, and migration-before-long-lived-connection.
- Production Session trash/restore/tombstone and durable Artifact-reference integration are present. Permanent deletion now explicitly removes the `ON DELETE RESTRICT` create-session journal before deleting the canonical Session, allowing FK cascades to clear timeline/result/retention/Artifact projections while retaining only the minimum tombstone.
- Artifact startup now validates DB-owned durable references and atomically writes the report before metadata reconciliation. Explicit degraded startup skips restoration for unavailable objects, and production reads return stable `artifact.unavailable`.
- RetentionLog restart loading is bounded and allow-listed; retention policies remain 30-day trash, 7-day Artifact orphan, 90-day audit, and 14-day diagnostics.
- RemoteHostInstaller now snapshots the pre-existing migration-backup set before starting the candidate. Failed readiness stops the JI user service, restores only candidate-created `*.pre-v*.backup` files after SHA-256 copy verification, removes matching WAL/SHM, switches to the previous binary, restarts it, and verifies readiness. No down migration or online-backup API was added.
- Fixed-scale performance runner no longer fills the bounded follow-up queue; it models real accept/remove transitions while generating exactly 10,000 replay events. It was rebuilt successfully but the external run could not reach a terminal result due to host capacity.
- Repository-external Gradle consumer passed. Real Apache Maven online/offline consumer passed on Ubuntu (`STAGE6_MAVEN_CONSUMER_OK`). Real OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic auth/non-stream/SSE/tool/usage/error/cancel smoke passed without logging credentials or payloads; Google remains contract/faux.
- Windows bundled-runtime standalone archive built and clean-unpack runtime/launcher smoke passed.
- SBOM generation now includes locked Java and pnpm dependencies plus staged artifacts in CycloneDX 1.6 and SPDX 2.3. Release artifacts have an Ed25519 signing/verification script; provenance materials include toolchain, Docker, SBOM, and provenance inputs. A truthful OS/browser/Provider matrix was added, keeping mobile devices, independent Relay security review, and registered-client OAuth as FOLLOW_UP.
- Focused regressions passed: Remote installer suite, Artifact lifecycle/degraded startup, SQLite permanent deletion, generated contracts, stage-gate contracts, and associated CLI/Host tests.

## External capacity blocker and honest partial evidence

The authorized Ubuntu host root filesystem reached 100% while running the mandatory fixed-scale performance and OCI/package gates. Only resources explicitly owned by this Stage 6 run were removed. Existing non-JI services, directories, images, containers, volumes, and Caddy were not modified; no global Docker prune was performed.

Performance rerun reached the full 1,000 Sessions / 100,000 transcript items dataset and again emitted passing partial metrics (cold ready 554 ms, list p95 2 ms, search p95 238 ms, Session first-page p95 1 ms), but it was terminated before ACK/replay/16 Tool effects/2 GiB Artifact/RSS/post-GC completion. These partial values are not a pass.

The Ubuntu release runner successfully executed pinned Node 24.20.0 dependency install, `verifyGenerated`, Java 21 build, and built Relay/Web/Ingress images in one attempt. Final OCI export/collection and package smoke did not complete because the filesystem exhausted. The current `scripts/run-stage6-ubuntu-release.ps1` is an in-progress runner and must be reviewed before reuse; its failed logs are evidence, not a green gate.

## Remaining required work

1. Obtain sufficient authorized JI-only capacity without deleting non-JI resources; rerun the complete fixed-size 2 vCPU/4 GiB performance gate without reducing scale.
2. Finish private signed Host bundle and OCI artifacts, hardened image smoke, install/upgrade/pre-migration-backup/failed-health rollback/package smoke, and final SBOM/signature/provenance generation against the final tree.
3. Review the full uncommitted diff and all new release scripts for correctness and minimal scope.
4. Run complete Stage 0–5 regression and Stage 6 aggregate gates plus generated/ACP/HCP/Buf/API/module/naming/lock/secret/runtime/submodule/process/port/cleanup/diff checks, serially.
5. Generate final-tree/commit-bound verification evidence and create the required local Conventional Commit only when every executable Stage 6 condition is truly green. Do not push or create a PR. Then route to independent Codex Stage 6 acceptance.

No Stage 6 completion, performance pass, OCI pass, or final gate pass is claimed.
